inputs.name: traefik_version
inputs.description: Traefik release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release tarball for each architecture, from the release's checksums file. Change these with traefik_version.

inputs.name: sites
inputs.description: Sites to route, by name. Each answers HTTPS requests for host and load-balances them across backends, a list of URLs such as "http://127.0.0.1:3000".

inputs.name: acme_email
inputs.description: Email address for the Let's Encrypt account. When set, Traefik gets a certificate for each site's host with the HTTP challenge. When null, sites use Traefik's self-signed default certificate.

inputs.name: acme_staging
inputs.description: Get certificates from Let's Encrypt's staging server, which browsers don't trust but which has far higher rate limits. For trying things out.

inputs.name: dashboard
inputs.description: Serve Traefik's dashboard and API on 127.0.0.1:8080, without authentication. Loopback only: reach it through an SSH tunnel.

inputs.name: access_log
inputs.description: Log every request to the journal.

inputs.name: docker_provider
inputs.description: Also route to Docker containers that opt in with the label traefik.enable=true. Needs Docker on the host, for example from circuit-docker, since the traefik user joins the docker group.
